column1: # base<TAB>arch<TAB>module<TAB>version<TAB>source
# Pinned per base and Debian architecture — different targets may run
# different module versions or consume arch-specific source repositories.
# Build ORDER within a base matters: doca (OFED) before nvidia-open —
# nvidia_peermem links against OFED's Module.symvers.
# NOTE: production DOCA is a custom MRC build (NOT these public repos, and
# Canonical's doca-ofed repackaging is equally inapplicable). The
# linux.mellanox.com pins below are the PIPELINE TEST stand-in; swap source
# to the MRC artifact location when wiring production builds.
# A DOCA URL names the repository for noble (ubuntu24.04). For another series,
# scripts/build-modules.sh takes the repository of that series (ubuntu26.04 for
# resolute): DOCA publishes one repository per Ubuntu release.
# 7.0, amd64: built, packaged, installed and loaded in a VM on noble and on
# resolute (2026-11-13). Not tested on hardware. arm64 is not built.
# hwe-6.17, amd64: the same on noble (2026-11-13).
# 7.3-lts. Built, packaged and installed for amd64 on noble (2026-11-13), and
# loaded in a VM. Not tested on hardware. Nothing for arm64 or resolute yet.
# DOCA 3.5.0 needs one patch of ours to compile against 7.3
# (modules/doca/patches/3.5.0/, and docs/modules.md "DOCA on 7.3-lts").
